title: ONE CLICK MAX LEVEL Insta Kill + Auto Boss + MORE!
features:
- 1 Click Level Up: takes the best quest for your level and farms it on repeat
- Insta Kill with HP threshold and range
- Auto pick up drops
- No sun damage for demons
- Auto Quest with quest picker and auto accept
- Auto Farm Mobs with mob picker and nearest mode
- Auto Boss for all 33 world bosses and minibosses, waits at spawn
- Kill Aura and Auto Skills
- Farm position (behind, front, above, below), distance, height and attack delay
- Weapon slot picker with auto equip
- Auto collect chests
- TP back on death, stop when dead and low health retreat
- Walkspeed, jump power, infinite jump, noclip and fly
- Teleports to every region, NPC, boss spawn and training spot
- ESP for mobs, bosses, players, chests, loot and NPCs
- No fog, blur, shadows, particles and full bright
- Live player info and quest progress
- Discord webhook for level ups, boss kills and drops
- Server hop and rejoin
